headline: EBRD and Iraqi Private Banks League Discuss Expanding SME Financing Facilities
summary: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development met with the Iraqi Private Banks League to explore expanding trade and SME credit lines. Separately, Iraq announced releasing $1 billion to pay outstanding contractor debts.
why: Development bank credit lines increase liquidity access for private sector small businesses in post-conflict emerging economies.

entities.name: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development
